title: To designate the United States Federal Judicial Center located at 333 West Broadway in San Diego, California, as the "John Rhoades Federal Judicial Center" and to designate the United States courthouse located at 333 West Broadway in San Diego, California, as the "James M. Carter and Judith N. Keep United States Courthouse".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on December 9, 2014. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the U.S. Federal Judicial Center and the U.S. courthouse located at 333 West Broadway in San Diego, California, as the "John Rhoades Federal Judicial Center" and the "James M. Carter and Judith N. Keep United States Courthouse," respectively.

summary.headline: Congress named a San Diego federal building and courthouse after two former federal judges and officials.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the federal judicial center at 333 West Broadway in San Diego as the John Rhoades Federal Judicial Center. It also renames the United States courthouse at the same address as the James M. Carter and Judith N. Keep United States Courthouse. The law does not change how the buildings operate or who uses them.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
